results.snippet: Files.com is a file orchestration platform that automates file synchronization across cloud storage providers including AWS S3, Azure, Google Cloud, Box, SharePoint, and OneDrive. Workflow automation and webhooks allow IT and data engineering teams to configure reliable, scheduled, or event-driven file sync between systems without manual intervention.

results.title: File Transfer Notifications & Webhooks — Files.com
results.snippet: Webhooks keep retrying for about three days if a delivery fails, and email you if they keep failing, so an event your app missed during a deploy still gets through. Notifications push events outward as they happen. If you need the retained, queryable history of everything — the kind you search months later or stream to your security tools — that’s the audit log, a separate record.
